fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA)

fields.name: BRANCH ID
fields.description: Branch code where the account was opened/operated from.

fields.name: REPORTING DATE
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: CUSTOMER ID
fields.description: Customer unique id linked to the account.

fields.name: DERIVATIVE ID
fields.description: A unique identifier for the financial derivative instruments

fields.name: COUNTERPARTY ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the counterparty

fields.name: UNDERLYING ASSET
fields.description: A financial asset upon which a derivatives price is based. E.g. Oil, stock, commodities, etc.

fields.name: DERIVATIVE TYPE
fields.description: A derivative is a security that derives its value from an underlying asset. Common derivatives include: Future contracts, options, swaps and forwards.

fields.name: DERIVATIVE SUB TYPE
fields.description: Possible options for (1) Futures {Commodity futures: Energy, Metals and Agriculture, Financial Futures: Currency futures, Treasury futures and Equity futures}, (2) Forwards {Currency forwards, interest rate forwards and commodity forwards}, (3) Options {Call options and Put options} and (4) Swaps {Credit default swaps, Interest rate swaps, Currency swaps, Commodity swaps and Equity swaps}

fields.name: INTER BANK SECTOR CODE
fields.description: Code assigned to the particular trade. {e.g. FK1,FK2, FN1,FN2,SK1,SK2,SN1,SN2. etc}

fields.name: CONTRACT START DATE
fields.description: The Derivative contract commencement date. Format {DD- MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: TRADE DATE
fields.description: The date of the commitment to buy or sell the financial instrument (Near Date). Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: SETTLEMENT DATE
fields.description: The date of the delivery of the asset. Format {DD-MMM- YYYY}

fields.name: MATURITY DATE
fields.description: The Derivative maturity date (Far Date). Format {DD-MMM- YYYY}

fields.name: CURRENCY TRADED
fields.description: ISO currency code of the currency traded as per ISO-4217. {e.g. USD, GPB, EUR, KES. etc.}

fields.name: NOTIONAL AMOUNT
fields.description: Face value of the Financial Instrument

fields.name: AMT IN TRADED CURRENCY
fields.description: Base Amount in transaction currency at commencement

fields.name: AMT IN LCY EQUIVALENT
fields.description: Amount in Kenyan currency (KES)

fields.name: MARKET VALUE
fields.description: The value of the financial derivative in Kenyan currency

fields.name: POSITION LNG SHT
fields.description: Buy or Sell

fields.name: PRICE INTEREST RATE
fields.description: Price/ Interest rate marked on the Financial Derivative.

fields.name: SPOT EXCHANGE RATE
fields.description: The spot exchange rate marked in the system (Near Rate).

fields.name: FORWARD EXCHANGE RATE
fields.description: The forward exchange rate marked in the system (Far Rate).

fields.name: FAR BASE VOLUME
fields.description: Base amount at maturity

fields.name: FAR AMOUNT IN LCY
fields.description: Amount in Kenyan currency (KES) at maturity
